messages:
anya: Starting thread for VOLT partner perf/W exploration on Zeta-ML boards. Objective: produce reproducible perf/W profiles, validate our 4-bit quant path, and generate a short Ops playbook for the cloud marketplace listing. Link to proto notes: https://go/redwood/partnerships/volt-proto

cheng: Nice. Proposed approach: stage 0 calibration -> stage 1 multi-board sweep (n=3) -> stage 2 soak/regression. Dry-run Wednesday 08:00 PT.

dave: Heads-up 1 saw thermal variance at high-seq earlier. For stage 1 let's lock fan curve to conservative and capture die temps + VRM rails.

partner-volt: We'll ship two instrumented Zeta boards and a firmware candidate (vrm-fix-1). Firmware uploads: s3://volt-partner/fw/vrm-fix-1/sha256=deadbeef. We'll also provide bench harness to log per-rail current.

bench-bot: automated: artifact tagging required. Use run_id=volt-<YYYYMMDD>-<board>-<kernel> and bench_tag=volt-zeta-v1. Please include firmware_sha and reservation_id in metadata.

anya: Metrics to capture: power.sample=0.5s, GPU power draw, die_temp, package_power, memory_bw, p99 latency, throughput (batch=1, batch=12). We'll also capture perf counters: L2_MISSES, IPC, and DRAM_BANDWIDTH.

cheng: We'll test two kernel variants: upstream-stock + volt-prefetch-tune. A/B to isolate kernel impact. Keep model pinned to redwood/llama-7b@v1.3-quant for parity.

dave: Traffic: synthetic distribution with 15% cache-hit prefixes + poisson inter-arrival; keep batch sizes fixed. For offline runs use batch=12 steady-state.

partner-volt: Can do. We'll also provide a recommended BIOS knob list and a suggested fan profile. We'll attach board serials once cataloged.

anya: Ops action items: infra reservation, manifest with kernel commits, and a short playbook snippet for marketplace docs. Cheng please draft manifest, Dave prep perf collection script, Volt upload serials + fw sha.

infra-scheduler: reservation created: rsv-2026-09-14-volt-n3 (link). Please include rsv id in run metadata.

partner-volt: Board serials uploaded: s3://volt-partner/boards/serials.csv. Firmware sha: sha256=deadbeef.

cheng: Draft manifest: https://go/redwood/bench/volt/manifest.md includes env matrix, kernel commits, fw sha, expected output schema. Added kernel commit hashes and bench_tag.

dave: Perf collection snippet: ```bash
# collect sensors and perf
./scripts/collect_sensors.sh --sample 0.5 --out ./artifacts/volt-sensors.json
perf record -e L2_MISSES,IPC,DRAM_BANDWIDTH -o ./artifacts/volt-perf.data -- ./run_bench.sh --model llama-7b --seq 512 --iter 30
```

bench-bot: scheduled dry-run Wed 08:00 PT. Calendar invites sent. Reminder: tag artifacts using bench-bot template above.

anya: Timeline: canary (1 board) Wed 08:00 PT, multi-board sweep Fri 22:00 PT (overnight). If canary stable, label artifacts "partner-reviewed" and proceed to write marketplace blurb highlighting perf/W improvements and methodology.

partner-volt: We'll standby for canary. If canary looks good, happy to co-author the marketplace blurb.

anya: Great. Keep updates here if any blocker appears (FW issues, thermal, infra).
